query: What are the thematic fields covered by Horizon Europe?
response:
Horizon Europe (€95.5 billion) is structured around three main Pillars, with the core thematic research areas organized under Pillar II, known as 'Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness'.

### The Three Pillars of Horizon Europe

| Pillar | Focus Area | Key Programmes |
|---|---|---|
| **Pillar I: Excellent Science** | Focussed on fundamental and frontier research, fostering highly skilled researchers and world-class infrastructures. | European Research Council (ERC), Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), Research Infrastructures (RI) |
| **Pillar II: Global Challenges & European Industrial Competitiveness** | Addresses key societal challenges and reinforces EU technological and industrial capacities through collaborative projects (RIA, IA, CSA). This is where the six thematic Clusters reside. | Thematic Clusters, Joint Research Centre (JRC) |
| **Pillar III: Innovative Europe** | Aims to boost breakthrough innovation, scale up market-creating innovators, and support the integration of research and education. | European Innovation Council (EIC), European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT) |

---

### Pillar II: The Six Thematic Clusters

The most comprehensive thematic fields are covered by the six Clusters under Pillar II. These Clusters define the scope for the Work Programmes and the large-scale collaborative Research and Innovation Actions (RIA) and Innovation Actions (IA):

| Cluster Code | Thematic Field | Primary Focus |
|---|---|---|
| **Cluster 1** | **Health** | Health security, non-communicable and rare diseases, innovative and sustainable healthcare systems, environment and health. |
| **Cluster 2** | **Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society** | Democracy and governance, cultural heritage, social and economic transformations, and artistic innovation. |
| **Cluster 3** | **Civil Security for Society** | Disaster resilience, border management, infrastructure protection, fighting crime and terrorism, and cyber security. |
| **Cluster 4** | **Digital, Industry and Space** | Digital and emerging technologies (AI, Robotics), materials, manufacturing processes, circular economy, and space exploration. |
| **Cluster 5** | **Climate, Energy and Mobility** | Climate science, clean energy systems (renewables, batteries, hydrogen), sustainable and smart mobility, and energy efficiency in buildings/industry. |
| **Cluster 6** | **Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture and Environment** | Sustainable agriculture, food systems, biodiversity, circular economy, clean water, and bio-based innovation.

### Cross-Cutting Priorities

In addition to the Clusters, Horizon Europe integrates several cross-cutting policy goals into all thematic areas:

*   **European Missions:** Five large-scale initiatives aiming to deliver tangible solutions to global challenges by 2030 (e.g., Cancer, Climate-Neutral Cities, Healthy Oceans, Soil Health).
*   **Widening Participation and Strengthening the European Research Area (ERA):** Actions to support countries with lower R&I performance and promote institutional changes (e.g., Teaming, Twinning).
*   **Gender Equality:** Requirement for all participating public bodies and higher education institutions to have a Gender Equality Plan (GEP).

---

### Next Steps and Resources

To find specific topics within these thematic fields, you must consult the official Work Programmes for the relevant Cluster or Pillar.

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for your cluster
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
